## 1. Record a route

::: {.demo}
Capture the path on site, one corridor segment at a time.

```{=html}
<video autoplay muted loop playsinline controls data-autoplay preload="metadata" aria-label="Recording an indoor route" data-external="1">
  <source src="videos/track.mp4" type="video/mp4" data-external="1">
  Your browser does not support embedded video. <a href="videos/track.mp4">Download the recording demo.</a>
</video>
```
:::

## 2. Walk it back

::: {.demo}
Follow a saved route from its repeatable starting point.

```{=html}
<video autoplay muted loop playsinline controls data-autoplay preload="metadata" aria-label="Walking a recorded route" data-external="1">
  <source src="videos/walk.mp4" type="video/mp4" data-external="1">
  Your browser does not support embedded video. <a href="videos/walk.mp4">Download the walking demo.</a>
</video>
```
:::

## AR navigation

::: {.demo}
See visual guidance placed in the space around you.

```{=html}
<video autoplay muted loop playsinline controls data-autoplay preload="metadata" aria-label="WebXR augmented reality navigation" data-external="1">
  <source src="videos/ar.mp4" type="video/mp4" data-external="1">
  Your browser does not support embedded video. <a href="videos/ar.mp4">Download the AR demo.</a>
</video>
```
:::

::: {.note}
Safari browser on iPhone does not support WebXR so far.
:::
